title: TNFR1 expression on cancer cells mediates immune escape and an immunosuppressive microenvironment.
snippet: TNFα is a proinflammatory cytokine that can mediate immunosuppressive effects in cancer. Tumors in which we silenced TNFR1 by CRISPR/Cas9 showed that TNFR1KO variants poorly engrafted in immunocompetent hosts, while engraftment in immunodeficient or CD8 T lymphocyte-depleted mice was preserved.
